name: BinaryContext
what_it_does: SHA-256-keyed JSON session anchor. Parses ELF32/64 (12+ ISAs: x86-64/ARM64/ARM32/MIPS/PPC/RISC-V/LoongArch64/ARC/V850/nanoMIPS/SH-2A/M88K) plus PE/XCOFF/M88K COFF. Caches state to disk.
outputs: BinaryContext with func_starts, plt, rodata, names table
limitations: Cache invalidated only by SHA-256 change

name: BinaryLifter
what_it_does: 13-ISA lifting. ARM64/x86-64: full NativeVal typed register state (ctype,expr,is_ptr,tainted,uses). ARM32/MIPS/PPC/RISC-V/LoongArch64/ARC/V850/nanoMIPS/SH-2A/x86-32: structural IR. M88K: string op_str only.
limitations: M88K: string op_str — taint cannot query by operand type

name: BeamContext
what_it_does: Parses Erlang BEAM bytecode: module atoms, exported functions, literals, call graph. sweep_beam_dir scans dirs; sweep_beam_diff diffs two versions.

name: CFGBuilder (arch-agnostic)
what_it_does: Arch-agnostic capstone CFG builder. Security gap methods detect auth-check bypasses, error-path security holes, and auth-bypass-via-error-path patterns.
outputs: CFG with basic blocks/edges; security gap findings
doc_notes: Security-gap methods not in main docs

name: DataflowEngine / MFPEngine
what_it_does: Meet-over-all-paths fixpoint engine. Includes ConstPropAnalysis, ReachingDefsAnalysis, SCCPAnalysis, DomTree, LoopInfo. ARM32/ARM64/Thumb2 configs built-in.
doc_notes: analysis-engine.md documents only 3 of 9 per-arch engines — HIGH mislead risk
limitations: Loop convergence depends on lattice height

name: Structurizer
what_it_does: Dominator-based CFG structurizer producing SequenceNode/IfNode/WhileNode/BreakNode/ContinueNode/ReturnNode/InsnNode AST.

name: EncodingDAG
what_it_does: Bidirectional instruction encode/decode DAG via Field/Template declarations. Used by PEFABIClobberScanner and SinkArgClassifiers for bitfield extraction.
outputs: Decoded Instruction with named fields OR encoded integer
limitations: Variable-length ISAs need separate handling per width

name: ExprLifter
what_it_does: Lifts binary instructions to ExprNode trees. ValueNumberer applies GVN to identify equivalent sub-expressions.

name: EntropyMapper
what_it_does: Sliding-window Shannon entropy scanner. Identifies high-entropy (encrypted/compressed), low-entropy, and transitions.
limitations: Window size fixed; algorithm not identified

name: WindowAnalyzer
what_it_does: Annotated x86-64 disassembly window around a VA with BinaryContext name annotations. Used for manual verification only — semantic sweep first per CLAUDE.md.
limitations: x86-64 only; no control flow annotation

name: XRefGraph
what_it_does: Call cross-reference graph: callers/callees per function VA. from_context avoids rebuilding BinaryContext.

what_it_does: ARM64 taint tracker. Four constructors: from_path (ELF), from_path_full (all sections), from_path_ko (Linux .ko kernel module), from_context. Interprocedural depth-4 BFS.
scope: AArch64 ELF; Linux ARM64 kernel modules

name: ARM32TaintTracker
what_it_does: ARM32 taint tracker. Handles ARM/Thumb/Thumb2 mode switching. r0-r3 arg registers. Intraprocedural.

name: TaintTracker (ARM32 labeled)
what_it_does: Labeled taint tracker for ARM32/Thumb2 instruction streams. Taint(labels,bound) model.
limitations: Requires structured Insn stream; no from_path

name: TaintTrackerI386 (legacy)

doc_notes: No classmethods — violates architecture.md; superseded by X86_32TaintTracker

name: BssTaintTracker
what_it_does: Tracks taint through BSS/global variable reads and writes in x86-64 ELF. Identifies global state that carries tainted data between functions.

name: TaintedStringTracker
what_it_does: Tracks tainted strings: identifies when user-controlled data enters format-string construction paths.

name: WindowsPoolTaintTracker
what_it_does: Tracks taint through Windows kernel pool allocations (ExAllocatePool*/ExFreePool*) and IOCTL buffer paths in Windows kernel drivers (.sys).
limitations: Windows PE only; no Linux support

name: MIPS32TaintTracker
what_it_does: MIPS32 O32 ABI taint. Handles delay slots. 11 sources, 21 sinks. Confirmed on RouterOS/Cisco/Broadcom.
limitations: No from_context; no stack taint; no loop fixpoint

name: MIPS64TaintTracker
what_it_does: MIPS64 N64 ABI taint. 8 arg regs ($a0-$a7). MFHI/MFLO handled conservatively. Confirmed on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE.
limitations: No stack taint; no loop fixpoint

name: TaintTracker (MIPS labeled)
what_it_does: Labeled taint for MIPS32/MIPS64 instruction streams. Taint(labels,bound) lattice. TaintState.

name: NanoMIPSTaintTracker
what_it_does: nanoMIPS variable-width (16/32/48-bit) taint. Requires Capstone 6.x for full decode; conservative fallback on CS5. BALC/JALRC call detection.
doc_notes: 4 known anomalies: KA-001 CS5 FPs, KA-002 P48 not modelled, KA-003 indirect JALRC, KA-004 no loop fixpoint
limitations: No from_context; P48 not tracked; CS5 over-approximates

name: PPC32TaintTracker
what_it_does: PPC32 SysV/EABI taint. GOT2 PIC resolver for Huawei bootloaders. Per-function r30 PIC anchor. Handles standard PLT and GOT2 indirect calls via CTR.
doc_notes: DOC MISMATCH: doc says 'taints r3 from return value'; code taints buffer register (r4 for recv/read, r3 for fgets). Misleading — could cause false-negative assumptions.
limitations: No stack taint; GOT2 internal callee gaps

name: PPC64TaintTracker
what_it_does: PPC64 ELFv1/ELFv2 taint. Extends PPC32 to 64-bit. Supports BE (AIX/old Linux) and LE (OpenPOWER). Simpler than PPC32: no GOT2 resolver.
doc_notes: HIGH MISMATCH: doc claims 'same labeled-taint model as ARM64TaintTracker'. FALSE — PPC64TaintTracker uses Dict[str,bool] boolean taint, NOT Taint(labels,bound). Labeled version is taint_tracker_ppc_labeled.py.
limitations: No stack taint; ELFv1 stripped requires Ppc64ElfV1Resolver preprocessing; TOC-slot gaps

name: TaintTracker (PPC labeled)
what_it_does: Labeled PPC32/PPC64 taint. Taint(labels,bound) model. LMW/STMW multi-register load/store, ISEL, CR logic, FP moves. _zext32 for PPC64.
doc_notes: NO reference doc found — undocumented in reference-modules/

name: RISCV32TaintTracker
what_it_does: RV32GC taint. RVC compressed instructions (c.jal/c.jalr). a0-a7 arg regs. ext_decoder for HiSilicon custom opcodes. Confirmed on SiFive/ESP32-C3/GD32VF103/Milk-V Duo.
doc_notes: 4 anomalies: KA-001 Capstone 4.x fails, KA-002 HiSilicon custom opcodes need ext_decoder, KA-003 RVC multi-reg not tracked, KA-004 indirect JALR not followed

name: RISCV64TaintTracker
what_it_does: RV64GC taint. Same structure as RISCV32TaintTracker but lp64 ABI. a0-a7 arg regs (x10-x17). RVC support.

name: TaintTracker (RISC-V labeled)
what_it_does: Labeled taint for RV32/RV64 instruction streams. Taint(labels,bound) model. RVC handling.

name: ARCTaintTracker
what_it_does: ARC HS/EM taint tracker. r0-r7 arg registers. ENTER_S/LEAVE_S compact call/return patterns.

name: TaintTracker (ARC labeled)
what_it_does: Labeled taint for ARC instruction streams. Taint(labels,bound) model.

name: LoongArch64TaintTracker
what_it_does: LA64 taint. lp64 ABI. PCADDI/PCALAU12I+ADDI.D global address patterns. Interprocedural depth=4 BFS. Confirmed on TencentOS kernel (62k+ functions).

name: TaintTrackerRH850
what_it_does: Renesas RH850 (automotive MCU, V850 successor) taint tracker. r6-r9 arg regs, r10 return. Automotive-specific syscall patterns.

name: TaintTrackerTriCore
what_it_does: Infineon TriCore taint (Bosch ECUs, fuel injection, transmission control). D[4]-D[7] arg data regs, A[4]-A[7] arg address regs. CALL/CALLI/RET, LD/ST patterns.

name: TaintTrackerV850
what_it_does: NEC/Renesas V850 taint (older automotive ECUs). r6-r9 arg regs. ld.b/ld.h/ld.w, st.b/st.h/st.w load/store forms.

name: CrossBinaryTaintTracker
what_it_does: Extends single-binary taint across shared library boundaries via LibGraph. Propagates taint from seed functions through inter-binary calls. Builds TaintChain records with TaintHop entries per binary hop.
limitations: Per-binary TaintTracker instantiated per hop — may be slow on large firmware

name: LibGraph
what_it_does: Multi-binary import/export dependency graph from firmware directory. Bidirectional symbol caller/callee maps. BFS call-chain finder. Lazy BinaryContext instantiation per binary.
inputs: Firmware directory or list of paths
outputs: LibGraph with caller/callee maps; BinaryContext objects
limitations: context() is lazy — first call triggers full BinaryContext build

name: SourceTaintTracker
what_it_does: Source-code-level taint. Builds CallGraph from parsed function defs. Propagates taint from source→sink through call graph. TaintPath with line numbers. Confidence attenuated at >2 hops.

name: SourceSinkScanner
what_it_does: Finds dangerous source→sink paths in Python source code. User-controlled input to dangerous API calls. Source/sink catalogs for Python.

name: SourceEntryClassifier
what_it_does: Classifies Python web framework route patterns: Flask/FastAPI/Django decorators, handler function identification, input parameter annotation. RouteClassification records route/method/handler/input sources.

name: SourceArchRiskScanner
what_it_does: Scans Python source for architectural risk: eval/exec, subprocess shell=True, pickle deserialization, YAML unsafe load, XML XXE, os.system. Composite risk score.

name: SourceAuditCompressor
what_it_does: Groups source files into risk-profile buckets to prioritize audit effort. priority_reads=high-risk buckets (exec+network/auth); spot_checks=medium; batch_clean=confidently low-risk.

name: SourceIngestion
what_it_does: Ingests source directories into SourceContext: file enumeration, encoding detection, AST-level function/class extraction, import graph construction. Source-analysis entry point analogous to BinaryContext.

name: SourceIsolationChecker
what_it_does: Checks for privilege isolation in source: setuid/privilege drop before exec, process separation, sandbox usage (seccomp/namespaces). Complements PrivDropBeforeExec for binary analysis.

name: PrivDropBeforeExec
entry_point: module functions; traces exec call sites backward
what_it_does: Checks that setuid binaries call setuid/setgid/setresuid before any exec() family call. Traces from exec call sites backward through call chain looking for privilege drop.
outputs: Findings where privilege drop is absent before exec
limitations: Binary-level only; complements SourceIsolationChecker for source

name: PthreadOnceDetector
what_it_does: Detects pthread_once usage: finds PLT entry, all call sites, traces whether once_control is global (safe) or local (data race risk). PthreadOnceResult records call_site_va, once_control_va, race_possible.

name: DeprecatedFuncScanner

what_it_does: XCOFF32/XCOFF64 parser: file header, section headers, symbol table (COFF/XCOFF extended), loader section (import/export), relocations. Resolves function descriptors (.opd). Used by BinaryContext._build_xcoff.

name: M88kCoffParser
what_it_does: Parses Motorola M88000 COFF format. Extracts section headers, symbol table, string table. Used by BinaryContext._build_m88k.

name: APKParser + DEXFile
what_it_does: APK (ZIP+AXML AndroidManifest.xml) parser: permissions, components (activities/services/receivers/providers), exported entry points, native libs. Full DEX bytecode parser: string/type/method pools, class defs.

name: MachoAnalyzer
what_it_does: Parses Mach-O binaries: load commands, segments/sections, symbol table, dynamic imports. Handles universal (fat) binaries.

name: FirmwareAnalyzer (core)
what_it_does: Firmware format detection and triage: entropy analysis, partition type detection, format fingerprinting. Internal to core/ — higher-level extraction in ablation/analyzers/.

name: GuardianPakExtractor
what_it_does: Extracts files from proprietary Guardian .pak container format.

name: BV41Decoder
what_it_does: Decodes BV41 compressed container format found in certain firmware images.

name: DisasmEngine
what_it_does: Thin wrapper around Capstone providing unified arch/mode initialization. Used by BinaryContext internal disasm.

name: ShellcodeUtils
what_it_does: Shellcode analysis helpers: position-independent detection, call/jmp destination resolution, encoding detection.

name: YaraGenerator
what_it_does: Generates YARA rules from binary patterns: selects high-entropy unique byte sequences as rule conditions.

name: ATTCKTagger
what_it_does: Maps RE findings to MITRE ATT&CK TTP IDs. Adds ATT&CK tags to finding output.

name: TLSAnalyzer
what_it_does: Analyzes TLS configuration in binaries: cipher suite detection, certificate pinning, weak TLS version usage.

name: SwiftDemangle
what_it_does: Demangles Swift symbol names. Wraps swift-demangle CLI or applies Python-based demangling.

name: PlatformDetect
what_it_does: Detects platform/OS/arch from binary metadata: ELF machine type, OS ABI, PE subsystem, Mach-O CPU type.

name: Prose / Render
what_it_does: Internal report generation utilities: markdown formatting helpers, finding report rendering, summary generation.

name: DockerEnumerator
what_it_does: Detects container context, Docker socket access, running containers/images/volumes/networks, privileged mode, dangerous capabilities, TCP 2375/2376 probe, risky Dockerfile patterns. Also standalone K8s/supply-chain checks.
limitations: docker CLI required for socket checks

name: KubernetesEnumerator
what_it_does: Enumerates Kubernetes cluster posture: RBAC roles, PSA policies, service accounts, secrets, network policies, OPA/Gatekeeper. ~5154 lines.

name: ForensicsEnum
what_it_does: Enumerates forensic artifacts: persistence mechanisms, recently modified files, crontabs, startup items, bash history, loaded kernel modules.

name: NetworkAnalyze
what_it_does: Active network analysis: open ports, listening sockets, established connections, routing table, iptables rules, ARP cache.

name: NetSniffer
what_it_does: Passive packet capture and analysis. Protocol dissection for common protocols.
outputs: List of captured packets with analysis

name: IOSEnum
what_it_does: Cisco IOS device enumeration via SSH/SNMP: device info, interfaces, routing, ACLs, VPN config, active sessions.

name: NXOSEnum
what_it_does: Cisco NX-OS (Nexus) device enumeration: VLANs, VPCs, feature list, BGP/OSPF, fabric configuration.

name: HyperflexEnum
what_it_does: Cisco HyperFlex HCI cluster enumeration: nodes, datastores, cluster health, API surface.

name: NexusDashboardEnum
what_it_does: Cisco Nexus Dashboard enumeration: fabric inventory, policy status, system health.

name: PrivEscEnum
what_it_does: Enumerates privilege escalation vectors: SUID/SGID binaries, sudo rules, capabilities, writable paths in root's PATH, cron jobs writable by non-root.

name: ProcessEnum
what_it_does: Enumerates running processes: PID/PPID, cmdline, open files/sockets, memory maps, environment variables, loaded libraries.
limitations: Root required for full memory maps

name: SIPEnum
what_it_does: SIP (VoIP) protocol enumeration: OPTIONS scan, user agent detection, extension enumeration, auth challenge detection.

name: StreamingEnum
what_it_does: Enumerates media streaming services: RTSP endpoints, HLS streams, authentication requirements.

name: SyscallTrace
what_it_does: Traces system calls of a process or binary execution via ptrace/eBPF.

name: PhysMemELFVFS
what_it_does: Analyzes physical memory dumps for ELF artifacts and VFS structures.

name: WindowsEnum
what_it_does: Windows system enumeration: services, registry keys, scheduled tasks, installed software, user accounts.

name: LateralMovement
what_it_does: Lateral movement techniques: pass-the-hash, SMB relay, WMI exec, SSH key reuse, kerberoasting. ~7817 lines.
limitations: Authorized red team use only; network access required

name: AgentAuthorityAudit
what_it_does: Maps PLT imports to 7 capability categories. Detects agent type (ai_agent/web_agent/cli_agent). Flags capabilities beyond what the agent type legitimately needs — confused-deputy pattern.
limitations: PLT-only; no dynamic dispatch; custom API hostnames not matched

name: AgentObservabilityAudit
category: AI agent security / audit trail absence detection
what_it_does: Checks for absent observability in AI agents: structured logging, HITL checkpoints, kernel audit trail. Gates on agent-indicator strings first.
limitations: HITL detection name-based only; fprintf counted as logging sink regardless of use

name: AgentToolSurfaceEnumerator
category: AI agent security / tool surface enumeration
what_it_does: Scans raw binary bytes for JSON MCP/OpenAI tool-definition schemas. Classifies tool names as HIGH-risk (shell_execution/code_execution/file_write/process_control/network_request/credential_access) or MEDIUM-risk (web_search/file_read).
limitations: Regex JSON proximity scan — FPs on dense rodata; runtime-defined tools not found

name: AIControlIndicators
what_it_does: Detects AI control-plane indicators in binaries: API keys, MCP server endpoints, tool registration patterns.

name: PolicyEngineAbsenceDetector
category: AI agent security / policy engine detection
what_it_does: Detects absence of policy engine or guardrail patterns in AI agent binaries. Checks for OPA/Rego/custom policy evaluation symbols.

name: TLSCipherSuiteAuditor
what_it_does: Audits TLS cipher suite configuration: identifies weak suites (RC4/DES/NULL/EXPORT), missing PFS, TLS 1.0/1.1 usage.

name: CertPinningDetector
what_it_does: Detects certificate pinning implementations: TrustKit, OkHttp CertificatePinner, custom pinning patterns in native code.
outputs: Pinning detection result with implementation type

name: CryptoKeyScanner
what_it_does: Scans binary/firmware for hardcoded cryptographic keys: PEM headers, DER patterns, AES S-box constants, RSA magic bytes.
limitations: High FP rate on compressed data

name: OpenSSLVersionDetector
what_it_does: Detects OpenSSL version from binary string patterns. Flags EOL versions (1.0.x/1.1.x).

name: MCPServerAnalyzer
what_it_does: Analyzes MCP server implementations: tool registration completeness, auth mechanism, input validation, transport security.

name: LLMApiSurfaceMapper
what_it_does: Maps all LLM API call sites in a binary: Anthropic/OpenAI/Azure/Google API endpoints, model IDs, temperature/max_tokens params.
outputs: LLM API surface map with call sites

name: PromptInjectionScanner
what_it_does: Detects prompt injection vectors: unsanitized user input directly in system/user prompts, f-string template injection into LLM calls.

name: InsecureMLModelLoader
what_it_does: Detects insecure ML model loading: pickle.load without safe_globals, torch.load without weights_only=True, ONNX models from untrusted paths.
outputs: List of insecure model loading findings

name: PathSolver
what_it_does: Z3-based symbolic execution to confirm path feasibility between source and sink. Step 5 in standard workflow. chain_depth_weight() adjusts severity by call chain depth.
doc_notes: path_solver should have its own doc — currently misattributed to dynamic-sandbox.md

name: ARM64GlobalTracker
what_it_does: Tracks ARM64 global variable writes via SSE (symbolic set expression) backward slicing. Decodes ADRP+ADD/LDR/STR/STP patterns without Capstone. Identifies which globals are written by which functions.
limitations: ADRP-only; no LDRP/other global access forms

name: InterprocFieldWriter
what_it_does: ARM64 interprocedural struct field write analysis. Tracks which GOT-relative struct fields are written by a function and its callees. FuncSummary records arg/global writes.

name: CppVtableReconstructorAnalyzer (modules)
what_it_does: Reconstructs C++ vtable layouts from stripped binaries. Identifies vtable data sections, extracts slot function pointers, names slots, infers class hierarchies. Modules version (separate from analyzers/vtable_resolver.py).

name: GoBinaryRE
what_it_does: Comprehensive Go binary analysis: pclntab parsing, goroutine stack trace analysis, interface type recovery, method table reconstruction.

name: GoGarbleRE
what_it_does: Recovers function names and type info from garble-obfuscated Go binaries using hash-seed brute force and pattern matching.
limitations: Brute force — slow on large binaries

name: GoDangerousCallers
category: Go Binary Analysis / Dangerous Call Detection
what_it_does: Detects dangerous function calls in Go binaries: os/exec, net/http.Get with user input, crypto/rand vs math/rand confusion.

name: CallsiteTracer
what_it_does: Traces all call sites of a function and their argument contexts. More detailed than XRefGraph.callers().
outputs: List[CallerInfo] with call site VA and argument state

name: IOCTLAttackSurface
what_it_does: Maps IOCTL dispatch table and command codes in Linux kernel modules and Windows drivers.

name: JavaDecompiler
what_it_does: Java .class bytecode decompiler producing Java-like pseudo-code.

name: JavaRE
what_it_does: Comprehensive Java RE: reflection analysis, deserialization gadget detection, classpath analysis.

name: MpyLifter
what_it_does: Lifts MicroPython .mpy compiled bytecode for IoT device firmware analysis.

name: ISA8051
what_it_does: Intel 8051 MCU instruction set decoder for legacy embedded firmware.

name: SPUDisassembler
what_it_does: IBM Cell Broadband Engine SPU (Synergistic Processing Unit) instruction set disassembler. Used for PS3 SPU RSX firmware.

name: SSESlicer
what_it_does: Extracts and analyzes SSE/AVX instruction sequences in x86-64 code. Used to identify vectorized crypto/hash implementations.
outputs: SSE instruction slice with semantic annotation

name: AmiCramfsExtractor
what_it_does: Extracts cramfs filesystem from AMI BIOS/UEFI firmware images.

name: BFFDecompressor
what_it_does: Decompresses AIX BFF compressed streams (complement to core/bff_extractor.py).

name: HuaweiSquashfsExtractor
what_it_does: Extracts squashfs filesystem from Huawei firmware images with custom header stripping.

name: InstallerBinaryAnalyzer
what_it_does: Analyzes software installer binaries: self-extracting archive detection, embedded payload extraction, script analysis.

name: VideoContainer
what_it_does: Parses video container formats (MP4/MKV/AVI) to extract embedded code/scripts or analyze for steganography.

name: Ppc32FuncDiscovery
what_it_does: Discovers PPC32 function starts in stripped binaries using stwu/mflr prologue patterns.

name: Ppc32Got2Resolver
what_it_does: Resolves PPC32 GOT2 base address (r30 anchor) for a given function. Used by PPC32TaintTracker.

name: Ppc32HeapSlotScanner
what_it_does: Scans PPC32 binaries for heap slot allocation patterns and potential overflow sites.

name: XcoffExecutableAnalyzer
what_it_does: Analyzes AIX XCOFF executable files: function inventory, export table, import library deps.

name: XcoffLoaderSymbols
what_it_does: Extracts loader-section symbols from AIX XCOFF binaries (import/export VAs).

name: BareAdapter
what_it_does: Creates a BinaryContext-compatible adapter for bare-metal ROM images without ELF headers.
inputs: Raw ROM bytes + arch + base VA

name: ARMDisasm
entry_point: disasm functions for ARM/Thumb; supplement to Capstone
what_it_does: ARM/Thumb disassembly supplement for cases where Capstone needs help (IT blocks, complex Thumb2 patterns).

name: ARMSymbolic
what_it_does: Symbolic register value tracking for ARM — lightweight alternative to full DataflowEngine.

name: HeapUAFScanner
what_it_does: Heap UAF, double-free, heap overflow in x86-64 ELF/PE. Intraprocedural Capstone analysis.

name: ChunkWalkerValidator
what_it_does: Detects TLV/chunk-advance loops without 4-byte alignment enforcement in x86-64 ELF. Flags ADD/LEA without AND alignment masking.

name: SetuidAuthOracleScanner
what_it_does: CWE-307 shadow auth oracle without rate-limiting: crypt() without rate-limit PLT imports. CWE-338 co-pattern: weak PRNG seeded with time().
limitations: x86-64 ELF ONLY — hard ValueError for non-x86-64

name: CVEScanner
what_it_does: Matches confirmed byte-level CVE signatures. Built-in: CVE-2011-3919 (libxml2, confirmed on IBM ISII), CVE-2012-5134 (pending), CVE-2012-2807 (pending).

name: BuildIntegrityAnalyzer
what_it_does: Checks ELF: PIE/NX/RELRO/stack-canary/FORTIFY. Checks PE: ASLR/DEP/CFG. One finding per absent/weak mitigation.

name: SupplyChainDetector
what_it_does: Identifies software supply chain indicators: embedded dependencies, version strings, known-vulnerable library patterns, SBOM-relevant metadata.

name: SignatureVerificationChecker
what_it_does: Checks code signing status: PE Authenticode, ELF GPG/RPM signature, macOS ad-hoc vs. Developer ID.

name: NetworkProtocolAnalyzer
what_it_does: Identifies embedded protocol implementations: MODBUS/DNP3/S7 (industrial), proprietary protocol fingerprinting.

name: CANDbcParser
what_it_does: Parses Vector DBC (CAN database) files for automotive network signal definitions.

name: ECUNissanParser
what_it_does: Parses Nissan ECU proprietary calibration format.

name: VersionTracker
what_it_does: Tracks function homologs across binary versions. Used in cross-version patch analysis workflow (step 3: DTWMatcher → MatrixProfileDiff → VersionTracker).

name: ScanResultVersionCache
what_it_does: Caches scan results keyed by binary SHA-256. Avoids re-running expensive scans when binary unchanged.
limitations: Cache invalidation on binary change only

name: ReportGenerator
what_it_does: Generates markdown vulnerability reports from findings. Used by fortinet_sweep and other sweeps.

what_it_does: Fast PLT import intersection for batch triage: filters a list of binaries to only those importing at least one exec-class sink. Used in fortinet_sweep directory mode Phase 0.
inputs: List of binary paths + sink symbol set

name: VendorProfile
what_it_does: Vendor-specific safe patterns and custom sink lists. Currently includes 'fortinet' profile. Used in fortinet_sweep Phase 3.

name: IPRegAnnotator
what_it_does: Annotates cross-library call sites with argument register values resolved interprocedurally. Used in CLAUDE.md step 8 (cross-library call chains).

name: RegAnnotator
what_it_does: Annotates x86-64 function register usage: identifies argument registers, save/restore sites, return register.

name: SyscallLoongArch64
what_it_does: Labels LoongArch64 syscall sequences: identifies syscall numbers, argument registers, return value handling. Referenced in loongarch.md.

name: PreAuthRouteAuditor
what_it_does: Identifies web service routes that are accessible pre-authentication (no auth gate check before handler execution).

name: ApacheModuleAnalyzer
what_it_does: Analyzes Apache httpd modules: ap_hook_* handler registration, module_entry structure, request processing hooks.

name: CMDBSurfaceMapper
what_it_does: Maps CMDB (configuration management database) API attack surface from binary.

name: CommandTableScanner
what_it_does: Scans for command dispatch tables (struct arrays of name+handler pointer) in binary .rodata. Maps command strings to handler VAs.
outputs: Command table inventory with handler VAs

name: FlatUIMethodDecoder
what_it_does: Decodes Flat UI method dispatch tables in proprietary embedded systems.

name: GoSubprocessScanner
what_it_does: Detects dangerous subprocess/exec patterns in Go binaries: os/exec.Command with user-controlled arguments.

name: CompilerSecurityGate
what_it_does: Checks for compiler security feature presence: stack canary, FORTIFY_SOURCE, SafeStack, shadow call stack.

name: LA64MaxNotMinScanner
what_it_does: Detects CWE-191 variant: comparing result of max() against minimum bound instead of maximum in LoongArch64 code.

name: I386CallChainResolver
what_it_does: Resolves call chains reaching a sink in x86-32 ELF. Used for interprocedural analysis on i386 targets.
outputs: Call chain from entry points to sink
